name: ImageGen
subtitle: Generate images with your local models

preferences.name: outputFolder
preferences.title: Save images to
preferences.description: Each image is saved here as a PNG named by date and prompt.

preferences.name: showProgress
preferences.title: Show progress in the HUD
preferences.description: A pill with a filling ring and the time left while an image renders. Click it to cancel.

preferences.name: showCard
preferences.title: Show a card when an image is ready
preferences.description: With Open and Show in Finder. The HUD always says when it's done.

preferences.name: closeOnGenerate
preferences.title: Close the launcher after Generate
preferences.description: The image keeps rendering in the background either way.

preferences.name: safeMode
preferences.title: Safe mode
preferences.description: Adds nudity and explicit content to every negative prompt.

preferences.name: saveSettings
preferences.title: Save settings beside each image
preferences.description: A .json file with the prompt, model, seed and options, to recreate it later.

preferences.name: modelsFolder
preferences.title: ComfyUI models folder
preferences.description: Where to look for models: checkpoints, diffusion_models, unet, loras, text_encoders and vae.

preferences.name: startCommand
preferences.title: Start ComfyUI with
preferences.description: Run when ComfyUI isn't answering. ImageGen waits up to 4 minutes for it.
